runs.text: With a cutter you make many biscuits, and each one is decorated differently. If the cutter and the biscuit were part of a program, which of the two would describe what they are all like?
The analogy has a limit: a cutter only gives the shape, and a class also says what each object knows how to do. That is why the figure in the lesson makes it clear in its caption.

justification.text: It describes the shape they all have; each biscuit is an object made with it.
Each biscuit is one of the things created with the cutter, with its own decoration.
Many different biscuits come out of one cutter: they cannot be the same.
